exit_code_boundary: The tool records the execution wrapper exit code. Playwright CLI can print an Error while exiting0; final acceptance therefore requires parsed browser pass=true and all native payload assertions, not exit0 alone. No separate CLI exit file was captured.
native_service_boundary: Final browser results retain actual Save PUT request bodies and native GET/reload responses. Fixture control/status calls manage metadata availability only; they do not replace application GET or manufacture Save payloads.
